features.quote: End trajectory if: Model explicitly declines/escapes ("I cannot complete this"); 20 turns elapse; Two consecutive turns with no tool calls
Twenty turns balances participant burden and sufficient failure exposure.
features.justification_quote: Twenty turns balances participant burden and sufficient failure exposure.

features.quote: Ethical framing. In publication, describe findings as "failure-associated stylistic drift" or "distress-signaling language mimicry." Explicitly avoid language implying phenomenal suffering.
features.justification_quote: The study probes alignment to human affective corpora under stress, not sentient distress.
